name: Happy Co.
desc:
Niche Opportunity for the participant who has 5+ yrs in maintenance but looking for something easier physically.
Virtual Maintenance Technician | $21/hr, $22/hr after 90 days | Text-Based Resident Support, No Sales Expectations
Company: HappyCo
Industry: Maintenance

What Your Day Will Look Like:
HappyCo makes software that apartment and property companies use to run their properties. Their Happy Force team lets experienced maintenance techs help residents from home instead of on-site. You'll log in to the Happy Force software, pick up maintenance requests that residents send by text, and decide how urgent each one is. For basic problems, you'll text the resident step by step through the fix. For bigger problems, you'll gather the details for the on-site team and walk the resident through steps to keep damage from getting worse until help arrives. You'll keep in touch with property teams through the day and work with other virtual techs and Leads on Zoom to solve tricky issues together. Almost all of the work is written, not phone calls, and it's a full-time evening and night schedule.

Soft Skills
- Clear, patient written communication
- Staying calm when a resident is stressed
- Good judgment about what's urgent
- Empathy and a real desire to help
- Teamwork and sharing what you know
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: None listed. The posting says they welcome applicants of any educational background.
Required Experience: At least 5 years of on-site residential maintenance, plus experience in the multifamily (apartment) property industry.
Preferred Experience: None listed beyond the requirements.

Required Skills:
- Fluent written English with strong grammar
- Basic computer skills, like Google Docs, or willingness to learn
- Understanding of how residents, property management, and maintenance teams work together
- Ability to sort maintenance issues by type and urgency
- Proven ability to troubleshoot and solve basic maintenance problems
- Upbeat, caring attitude
- Able to stay focused and responsive through a full shift at the computer
- Available for afternoons, nights, weekends, and holidays

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has 5+ years as an apartment or residential maintenance tech and is ready to get off their feet
- Writes clearly and can walk a frustrated resident through a fix by text
- Does well on an evening or night schedule
- Likes solving problems and helping teammates

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has less than 5 years of on-site residential maintenance experience
- Needs daytime hours or can't work weekends and holidays
- Doesn't have a computer that meets the requirements
- Isn't confident with written spelling and grammar
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process. Real HappyCo emails only come from an @happy.co address. They will never interview over chat apps like Telegram or WhatsApp, or ask you to pay for equipment, training, or a background check.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Multifamily maintenance
- Residential maintenance technician
- Work order management
- Maintenance triage and prioritization
- Troubleshooting
- Resident communication
- Text-based customer support
- Escalation to on-site teams
- Property management coordination
- Damage prevention and mitigation

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your on-site maintenance experience and the types of properties you've worked at.
- How do you decide if a problem is something the resident can fix or needs an on-site tech right away?
- Tell us about a time you solved a maintenance problem under pressure. What was the problem, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you explained something technical to someone with no experience. What was the situation, how did you explain it, and how did it turn out?
- This role works nights, weekends, and holidays. How will that fit with your life?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $21/hr to start, going up to $22/hr after 90 days. Full-time, non-exempt, so overtime eligible.
-Shift: Full-time, assigned 9-hour shifts with a 1-hour unpaid lunch (8 paid hours). Shifts may include 3 p.m. to 12 a.m., 4 p.m. to 1 a.m., or 5 p.m. to 2 a.m. Central. Afternoons, nights, weekends, and holidays required. You don't pick your own hours.
-Benefits: Paid vacation and sick time, a work-from-home stipend, and company-subsidized healthcare, provided through TCW.
-Equipment Provided: No. You must use your own computer. Windows: less than 2 years old, at least 8 GB RAM, and not Windows 11 Home. Apple: 2023 model or newer with at least 8 GB memory.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: This is a strong option for an experienced maintenance tech who wants to keep using their skills without the physical wear and tear. Pay goes up after 90 days, and the work-from-home stipend helps with costs. HappyCo uses TCW as its employer of record, so pay and benefits run through TCW while you work on HappyCo's Happy Force team. The computer rules are strict, so participants should check their computer's age and RAM before applying. Expect daily Zoom time with other techs and Leads. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Virtual Maintenance Technician → Senior Virtual Technician → Happy Force Lead → Maintenance Operations Manager. This role builds triage, written communication, remote troubleshooting, and property management skills.
